newsitem.title: USA: Alumax mill unit ups pricing.
newsitem.headline: Alumax mill unit ups pricing.

text.p: Alumax Inc said on Thursday that Alumax Mill Products was increasing its February common alloy sheet distributor production and depot pricing to reflect recent increases in the cost of aluminum ingot.
The company said that production orders for March were being entered price-in-effect and that March pricing would be firmed by February 21, 1997.

March pricing would reflect the change in metal value for the period of January 20 through February 14, compared with the average metal value for the period December 16 through January 17, the company said.
March pricing would also reflect a $0.03 per pound conversion charge increase that would be fully implemented on March 1 on all production orders, Alumax said.
